defaultPrompt: Art-direct this campaign end-to-end, using specialist review and strict design gates.
Sanitize these annotation notes before editing the image and protect non-target content.

interface.longDescription:
Designly helps you turn a brief, idea, or reference into polished visual work for ads, social posts, campaigns, and brand content

It helps shape the concept, composition, typography, imagery, and overall art direction, then reviews the result and guides precise revisions when something feels off

You can also use Designly to improve existing images without changing everything else, follow brand guidelines, handle Arabic and RTL layouts, and keep a consistent visual style across multiple assets
